amount_is_base_true.meaning: the FOK order is submitted with amountIsBase set to true

amount_not_divisible_by_lot.meaning: the order amount is not divisible by the lot size (report gives no numeric lot size or amount)

dust_tolerance_guarantee_violated_observ.meaning: the protocol's dust tolerance guarantee is violated during the FOK fill (only rounded-off dust remains unfilled)

assumptions: The FOK order is processed through _matchIncomingOrder(), _matchIncomingBid() and _processFillBidOrder() as described in the report.
Only the rounded-off remainder (dust) is left unfilled when the guarantee is violated.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete lot size or order amount, so the divisibility relation is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric modulo relation.
The dust tolerance guarantee's exact numeric threshold (dust < one lot) is not given as a numeric literal; the violation is encoded as a grounded Boolean observable.

limitations: The report does not state who submits the FOK order or any authorization condition; the plan covers only the amountIsBase-true, non-lot-divisible scenario.
The dust tolerance guarantee is formalized as a Boolean observable because no numeric lot size or dust threshold is supplied.
Other impacts (revert of FOK orders, unpredictable behavior) are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered here.
